# StudEat – final results

*Generated by `src/run_benchmark.py` on 2026-11-26.*

| Model | Val NDCG@10 | Test NDCG@10 | Test Recall@20 | Unwanted-meal rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Random (5 seeds) | 0.0010 ± 0.0004 | 0.0009 ± 0.0005 | 0.0027 ± 0.0010 | n/a |
| Most-Popular | 0.0375 | 0.0350 | 0.0838 | n/a |
| LightGCN (3 seeds) | 0.0379 ± 0.0002 | 0.0346 ± 0.0004 | 0.0869 ± 0.0017 | n/a |
| NLGCL (3 seeds) | 0.0401 ± 0.0004 | 0.0326 ± 0.0011 | 0.0803 ± 0.0046 | n/a |
| NLGCL fold-in (app score) (no risk control) | 0.0364 | 0.0321 | 0.0751 | 0.0218 |
| NLGCL fold-in (app score) + risk control (alpha = 0.015) | 0.0364 | 0.0321 | 0.0751 | 0.0195 |

**Protocol.** Temporal split produced by `src/data_pipeline.py`; every row is evaluated with the
shared harness `src/evaluation.py` (NDCG@10, Recall@20, full-catalogue ranking, already-seen items
masked, positives = ratings ≥ 4). Models are selected on validation (early stopping in `train.py`);
the test split is used once per checkpoint. Values are mean ± sample std (ddof = 1) over seeds [0, 1, 2]
(Random: 5 seeds; Most-Popular is deterministic).

**Data.** 10,194 users and 9,370 recipes in the training split,
121,207 positive training interactions; 5,912 positive test
interactions from 1,434 users.

**Reproduce.**

```bash
python src/run_benchmark.py --seeds 0 1 2
```

Checkpoints are not versioned: this trains every model, then evaluates it. Add `--skip-train` to
re-evaluate the checkpoints already in `models/benchmark`. The risk-control rows use the versioned
`models/embeddings.npz` and `configs/risk_threshold.json` (recalibrate with `python src/risk_control.py --foldin`).
